description: This file defines a web scraper class 'FarmhouseDelivery' for extracting recipe data from the 'farmhousedelivery' website, including title, ingredients, instructions, and image URL, handling multiple layout styles.

classes.name: FarmhouseDelivery
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe details from farmhousedelivery website, handling multiple layout styles for ingredients and instructions.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the domain string for the website.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Extracts the recipe title from the webpage.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Raises exception indicating total time info is not provided.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts ingredients list, supporting two different webpage layout styles.

methods.name: _instructions_list
methods.description: Cached property that extracts instructions as a list, supporting two layout styles.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Joins instructions list into a single string separated by newlines.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Extracts the URL of the recipe image.
